paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The effect of context masking on case tasks groupby by language family. Error bars indicate the standard deviation.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the effect on different language families, displaying bars grouped by category with sub-bars indicating different models or configurations. The horizontal axis contains categories labeled as language families, namely IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, presented in a left-to-right sequence and having nominal scale. The vertical axis is labeled "effect", using a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 40, marked at intervals of 5 units. Each category contains up to six bars representing different models or settings, namely mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂, colored light blue, dark blue, light green, dark green, pink, and red, respectively. Approximate values for the IE-Indic group range from around 17 to 23, showing variation among configurations, while the Uralic group has bars mostly below 5. The bars in the Semitic group, are from -8 to about 20, whereas the shortest are in the Uralic family, around 1–2. The chart does not explicitly prioritize or visually emphasize specific bars through shading or annotation. Each group within a category is visually separated, facilitating model-wise comparison within language families. The error bars indicate variability within the model effects for each linguistic tag, with semantic having bigger error bars for all its bars. A legend is given top right.
